veranderings.blok: Van die lug tot in die ruimte
veranderings.voor: dat ons dit die ruimte noem
veranderings.na: dat ons daardie plek die ruimte noem
veranderings.rede: 'dit' reads as referring to 'lug', so the sentence seems to call the air itself space; naming the place removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom sien jy die ander sterre eers in die aand?
veranderings.voor: Daardie sterre se lig kom wel deur
veranderings.na: Daardie sterre se lig kom wel tot by jou
veranderings.rede: 'kom wel deur' leaves open what the light comes through; 'kom wel tot by jou' says plainly that it reaches the viewer.
